messages:
Jordana: Quick design review request — I iterated on the trace header quick-actions. Primary asks: make 'Copy permalink' & 'Download JSON' clearer for screen readers and to avoid accidental downloads when people try to copy.
Mike: hmm can you paste the current labels?
Jordana: Current: [Copy link] [Export] (icons only in compact mode). Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xxx/trace-actions
Leigh: I think 'Export' is ambiguous. Users expect formats. Maybe split into 'Download JSON' + 'Copy link' and keep icon for compact.
Kevin: Product note: we have seen support tickets where customers clicked export thinking it copies the link. So yes — separate.
Beth: On export behavior — if we trigger a download we should show a toast with filename `trace-<id>.json` and an option 'Copy link' in toast.
Anna (a11y): For screen readers, 'Copy link' button should have aria-label='Copy trace permalink' and role='button'. For 'Download JSON' add aria-describedby pointing to an offscreen hint: 'Saves full trace data to your device.'
Mike: Implementation: currently the copy action uses navigator.clipboard.writeText and Export uses fetch + blob. I can add aria attributes; we should confirm keyboard focus order.
Jordana: Focus order proposal: Copy permalink (primary), Open in Request Drilldown, Download JSON (secondary). On small screens collapse into kebab menu, but ensure first item is 'Copy permalink'.
Leigh: Microcopy tweak: 'Open in Request Drilldown' feels long. Maybe 'Open in drilldown' or 'View request' — shorter and readable.
Kevin: 'View request' ok. Also add subtle tooltip on hover: 'Includes correlation IDs (span & trace)'.
Beth: Correlation ID visibility: make trace id copyable inline in header, with small copy icon and aria-label 'Copy trace id'.
Anna (a11y): Keyboard: ensure copy icon reachable via Tab and has visible focus ring. Also test NVDA/VoiceOver announcement after copy: 'Trace link copied to clipboard'.
Mike: One implementation question: toast + undo? If someone accidentally downloads they can't undo. Maybe show a small 'Open folder' link in toast for desktop.
Jordana: UX decision: avoid modal for export (too heavy). Toast with action buttons is enough.
Leigh: I'll update Figma and replace 'Export' with explicit labels, add aria annotations in spec.
Jordana: PTAL at updated figma (link) — will merge changes end of day. :thumbsup: 
ux-bot: Reminder — design review scheduled today 3pm in #design. :bell:
Kevin: Thanks all — will track follow-ups in the PR description.
